content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to use the [product_name] as a 4G router for remote access to the [product_name] Webserver? If yes, what steps should be followed? Best regards, [user_name]
Are you familiar with this [company_name] example? Setting up a secure VPN connection between a PC and [product_name]
It is possible to access remotely using the web server. However, uploading a customized web server via the [product_name] is not supported.
Refer to this topic: Why are user-defined web pages not fully displayed when accessed through the VPN connection of a [product_name]?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are investigating how to remotely access the [product_name] Webserver using the [product_name] as a 4G router. Although remote access through the web server is feasible, there are notable limitations. Customized web servers cannot be uploaded via [product_name], and user-defined web pages may not display correctly over a VPN connection. These constraints have led to uncertainty regarding remote customization and overall functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to utilize the [product_name] as a reliable 4G router for remote access and management of the [product_name] Webserver, with the ability to support customized web pages.
pain_keywords: inability to upload custom web server
